# UIGradient

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIGradient")`

Applies a gradient of color and transparency to its parent. Everything the parent draws, its background, image and text, is multiplied by `Color` and faded by `Transparency` along the gradient. Under a `UIStroke`, it colors the stroke instead.

It changes only how the parent is drawn, not its layout or hit testing. Only the first gradient under a parent is used.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Color` | `ColorSequence` | `ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))` | read/write | The colors along the gradient, multiplied by the parent's own colors. White changes nothing. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the gradient is applied. |
| `Offset` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.new(0, 0)` | read/write | An offset of the gradient's center, as a fraction of the parent's size: (1, 0) moves it one full width to the right. Negative values are allowed. |
| `Rotation` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The rotation of the gradient, in degrees clockwise. At 0, a linear gradient runs from left to right and a conical one starts pointing right. A radial gradient ignores it. |
| `Scale` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much of the parent one run of the gradient covers. At 1 it runs once across; at 0.25 it covers a quarter, and `TileMode` fills the rest. For a radial gradient it scales the radius, and for a conical one the sweep, up to one full turn. |
| `TileMode` | `Enum.GradientTileMode` | `Enum.GradientTileMode.Clamp` | read/write | What fills the area beyond the ends of the gradient: the end colors, the gradient repeated, or the gradient mirrored. It applies when `Scale` is below 1 or `Offset` moves the gradient. |
| `Transparency` | `NumberSequence` | `NumberSequence.new(0)` | read/write | The transparency along the gradient. 0 leaves the parent as opaque as it was, and 1 hides it. |
| `Type` | `Enum.GradientType` | `Enum.GradientType.Linear` | read/write | The shape of the gradient: a line across the parent, a circle outward from its center, or a sweep around its center. |
